digest.component_or_area: Local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles via layered config file, with all calls provider-clean and zero direct-Anthropic invocations
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate runs, not write-only
All three gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must parse structured output verdicts end-to-end on Bedrock without fallback to INDETERMINATE or unparsed shapes
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes, matching Anthropic cache_control default, with no observable difference in cache behavior across gate runs
Revert to Anthropic configuration must be single-step via unsetting REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE, with no modifications to infra/ directory
